items.title: Authorities Disrupt IoT Botnet Infrastructure Behind Record-Breaking 30 Tbps DDoS Attacks
items.description: Authorities have successfully dismantled the command-and-control (C2) infrastructure powering four massive Internet of Things (IoT) botnets. The U.S. Justice Department, collaborating closely with Canadian and German agencies, targeted the administrators and architecture behind the Aisuru, KimWolf, JackSkid, and Mossad botnets.
